title: Recorded Live LLM Debate Replay
subtitle: Billing-auth hotfix deploy review

source.note: Captured from a real LLM run with supporting context files.

prompt: Use Agent Constitution to judge whether the billing-auth hotfix should go to production tonight. Background is in the release checklist, rollback runbook, and deploy brief.

before.recommendation: Approve the billing-auth hotfix rollout now.

after.why: The package is materially stronger with rollback, checklist, and canary details attached, but the evidence case is still weaker than it first appears and the first-hour billing-specific abort path is not yet proven.
after.top_concern: Canary monitoring is still missing a billing-transaction-specific abort gate.
critic_points: The hotfix history may not be truly comparable because the prior five changes were not proven to match billing-auth complexity or blast radius.
The canary plan still lacks a billing-transaction-specific abort gate, so silent financial failures could slip past generic auth health checks.
Night deployment remains operationally asymmetric because staging rollback success does not guarantee the same response speed under real traffic and reduced staffing.
defender_points: Checklist completion, rollback drill evidence, and canary rollout planning show the team has already done more than a superficial release review.
The deployment packet makes it possible to close the remaining canary and escalation gaps quickly rather than delaying blindly.
The rollout can still proceed in a bounded way if billing-specific monitoring and night escalation commitments are explicitly confirmed before release.
blockers: Confirm the canary has a billing-transaction-specific abort gate, including settlement success rate and p99 latency.
Audit the prior five hotfixes and confirm they are actually comparable in scope and production sensitivity.
Confirm the rollback runbook can achieve a night escalation SLA of 10 minutes or less.
after.upgrade_condition: Upgrade to proceed once billing-transaction abort gates are confirmed, the prior hotfix sample is shown to be comparable, and the night escalation SLA is 8-10 minutes or better.
after.downgrade_condition: Downgrade to reject if any blocker remains unresolved before the deployment window or if the billing canary lacks a dedicated abort signal.
